name: Sack imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, hauling a huge bulging cloth sack of stolen glittering diamonds over its shoulders with both claws, bent under the weight, diamonds peeking out of a torn seam

poses.stand: hovering low on straining bat wings, bent under the huge diamond sack held on its back with both claws
poses.struck: just hit: the sack tearing open, a diamond spilling out, the imp squawking with eyes bulging
poses.dead: bursting into a puff of black soot and embers, the torn empty sack dropping with a few diamonds

idle.action: hovers low under the heavy sack, panting, wings straining

move.action: hauls the heavy diamond sack along in the air, wings straining, panting, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
